description: This file defines data structures and classes related to paragraph formatting and line measurements within the MigraDoc rendering engine, including VerticalLineInfo, LineInfo, and ParagraphFormatInfo.

classes.name: VerticalLineInfo
classes.description: Represents vertical measurements of a paragraph line, including height, descent, and inherent line space.

classes.name: LineInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a line within a paragraph, such as width, tab offsets, and vertical info.

classes.name: ParagraphFormatInfo
classes.description: Holds formatting information for a paragraph, including line info collection, state flags, and rendering details.

methods.name: GetLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves line information at a specific index.

methods.name: AddLineInfo
methods.description: Adds a new line info to the collection.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends line info from another FormatInfo object.

methods.name: RemoveEnding
methods.description: Removes the ending line(s) from the paragraph formatting info.
